ranking: SAL logit[0]-logit[1] + frame-overlap-average log(POS likelihood ratio)
inference_inputs: SAL logits; ASR text/time/confidence/POS; frozen train POS ratios
limitations: Development set was previously explored; not an untouched test.
POS likelihood ratio is a heuristic feature, not a calibrated fake probability.
Train POS counts use pure words and 10 ms truth; evaluation uses SAL native 160 ms truth.
Candidate coverage is not corrected detector accuracy or tIoU event recall.
Global offline duration budget; no deployment latency claim.
Zero-weight unknown/no-word regions retain acoustic fallback.
